summary: U2-c rev.3 verified end-to-end in LAB-LOCAL mode. L1 Deno suites PASS 139/139 (VALIDATOR 19/19, CONFORMANCE 37/37, TURN 58/58, INTERRUPTIONS 37/37) run twice; `deno check` on runtime+unit files is clean. L2 PostgREST lab via lab_u2c.py: CONFORMANCE 37/37, TURN 58/58, INTERRUPTIONS 38/38, residue=0|0|9, pass=True. Independent reproduction script in /tmp (file:/// imports, harness mocks) implementing T1..T10 reproduces the exact user defect scenario and PASSes 66/66 checks: after 'no' to Sunday consent the gate becomes 'blocked' with a kind='invalid_value' question whose only option is 'drop:dates' and notApplied.reason='refused_consent' (NOT a re-asked consent); replay of the same requestId returns a byte-identical cached response (diagnostics.claim='cached'); a second 'no' on the clarification is rejected 400 invalid_request committed and session revision stays at 2; irrelevant message ('Aggiungi anche Monza') keeps the SAME openQuestion id (no new consent), planner.calls=0, rev 3; set_date to a working day resolves to 'planned' at rev 4; returning to the refused date yields 'blocked' with kind='invalid_value' at rev 5 (refusal persisted, NOT needs_consent); in a fresh session the 'drop:dates' option produces result.applied[0]={op:'clear',field:'dates',evidence:''}, dates=[], consents=[], rev 3; getState after T2 exposes only the allowed public keys and shows gate='blocked', question.id = T2 question id, sessionRevision=2. Every response body validates against validateTransportResponse. No consent question is ever re-asked for the same (kind,date) scope; the server never mutates dates on its own; revision increases by exactly 1 per turn. Regressions clean: U1 run_deno.sh fail=0 (129+43+39+21); U2-a run_contract.sh fail=0 (368+31+10 Node+Deno). Tracked files untouched: `git diff --exit-code 259ec92d` rc=0; U1 gptour-semantic/*.ts and 01_semantic_migration.sql have no diffs; the only `??` entries are the new U2 directories expected to be untracked. No remote access, no real LLM, no git write, no files created under /app/voom-repo (temp script in /tmp removed).
critical_code_review_comments: refused-consent.ts correctly persists refusal keyed by (kind,date) in session-state.declined without exposing it in the public snapshot; refusedGate produces a kind='invalid_value' clarification with the single 'drop:dates' option and notApplied.reason='refused_consent', satisfying the no-reask invariant.
turn.ts correctly short-circuits planning when isRefused(declined) via refusedGate, keeping planner.calls=0 and preserving the user's data (dates NOT mutated by the server).

responses.ts errorTurn override of outcome ensures the collateral invalid_request (second 'no' on invalid_value) finalizes as outcome='committed' rather than leaking as storage_retryable; this matches the user-reported collateral finding.
replay semantics preserved: identical requestId returns byte-identical body with diagnostics.claim='cached' and no state mutation (session revision unchanged).

Public getState snapshot keys stay restricted to the whitelist (context, contractVersion, criteria, engineVersion, expiresAt, gate, notices, openQuestionCount, openQuestions, question, sessionId, sessionRevision); internal 'declined' is not leaked.

context_for_next_testing_agent: rev.3 passes all requested L1/L2 and the independent T1..T10 defect reproduction (66/66). No tracked files were modified (base 259ec92d, rc=0). D-U2C-02/03 remain open per docs/U2_C_RESULTS.md §5. If re-running, L2 requires /tmp/voom-u2-replay and /tmp/voom-u2-lab Postgres already up; use /opt/deno/deno (aarch64).
rca of the issue: User defect rev.2: a 'no' to the Sunday consent re-asked the SAME consent on the next turn (q4 rev 2, q6 rev 3). Root cause: refusal was not persisted scoped to (kind,date); each turn re-evaluated workingDays vs criteria.dates and re-raised 'consent'. Fix (rev.3, runtime-only): refused-consent.ts introduces a persisted 'declined' set keyed by (kind,date); session-state.ts stores it in the hidden session state (never exposed in snapshot); turn.ts computes declined=withRefusal(...) and, when isRefused is true, replaces the needs_consent gate with refusedGate producing a kind='invalid_value' clarification with the single option 'drop:dates' and notApplied.reason='refused_consent'. The server never mutates dates; only user-driven set_date or 'drop:dates' answer can resolve the clarification. Returning to the refused date remains blocked (refusal preserved). One revision per turn preserved; replay cached byte-identical. Collateral: finishError invalid_request is now committed (not storage_retryable). Reproduction via independent /tmp script (file:/// imports + harness mocks): all 66 assertions PASS.
